about: Reviewed translations of site-kit's UI strings and recurring restaurant terms (bord = restaurant table, Klart = done, Beställ hem = order delivery, sällskap = party). site-translate uses an entry instead of Amazon Translate when the whole Swedish text matches it. {0}, {1} stand for protected parts (numbers, times, prices, names) in the order they appear in the Swedish text; each must appear exactly once in every language. Spanish uses tu. Edit with care: tests/test_site_translate_glossary.py checks the shape.
